name: robots/ehehee__variational-automation-benchmark
title: Variational Automation Benchmark single-arm environment
intro: Variational Automation Benchmark single-arm environment, adapted from ehehee/variational-automation-benchmark. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `success`, `completion_rate` and 5 more; runs `step` and `reset_world`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
